text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, me head was hurtin', so I was 
thinkin' of stickin' an umeboshi on it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home, folks say stickin' it to your 
temples makes it better...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow ow... I gotta find that umeboshi 
soon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin seems to be suffering from a 
headache.
